ownerReport.text:
# Knowledge 14.0.0 final validation

PR: https://github.com/tangle-network/agent-knowledge/pull/190
PR commit: `29998a07db4fd8c1ca7e89bc3713911ebf128bca`.
Merged commit and tag `v14.0.0`: `30878397a947c37fd743929b30aa03728e785c76`.
The two commits have identical trees, checked with `git diff --exit-code`.

## Final dependency cohort

Knowledge 14.0.0 requires Eval `>=0.174.0 <0.175.0`, tested at 0.174.0.
The clean package install has one copy each of Eval 0.174.0, Core 0.9.6, Interface 2.0.0, and Zod 4.5.4.
The lockfile changed five lines and their replacements for Eval identity and integrity.

## Host checks

Execution: macOS, Node 24.11.1, pnpm 10.34.5.

- Source typecheck: `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`, passed.
- Contract typecheck: `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.contracts.json`, passed.
- Lint: `node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check src tests`, 249 files passed.
- Build: `./node_modules/.bin/tsdown`, passed in 2210 ms.
- Tests: `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/rag-improvement-loop.test.ts tests/loops/research-driving-loop.test.ts tests/loops/research-driving-driver.test.ts tests/claim-persistence.test.ts tests/memory/improvement.test.ts`, 85 of 85 passed in five files, 7.32 seconds.
- `pnpm verify:package`, passed for the final dependency cohort.
This includes API record, path containment, skill validation, publint, declaration resolution, clean install, imports, CLI version, and re-pack.
- The API record is current: 995 exports across six entrypoints.
Only the exported ResearchDriver shape changes.
- The committed `pnpm check:version-bump` passed and requires the authored major version.
- `git diff --check`, commit hooks, and push hooks passed.

The built artifact smoke completed two research rounds.
The second worker received steering with zero storage gaps.
The callback order was worker1, prepare, fold, checkpoint, publish1, worker2, checkpoint, publish2.
The result was ready only after driver completion.
The host correctly rejects Linux-only exact candidate execution.
No provider inference was called.

## Required Ubuntu CI

Run: https://github.com/tangle-network/agent-knowledge/actions/runs/34013062769

| Job | Tests | Files | Duration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ci | 862 passed, 7 conditional skips, 0 failed | 88 passed, 2 skipped, 90 total | tests 35.49 seconds; job 68 seconds | Success |
| official-optimizers | 2 passed, 0 failed | 1 passed | tests 6.48 seconds; job 80 seconds | Success |

CI uses Ubuntu 24.04 and Node 22.
The ci job runs with `AGENT_KNOWLEDGE_RUN_NETWORK_TESTS=1`.
The separate official-optimizers job executes both GEPA retrieval optimization and SkillOpt text optimization through the packed package.
The CI job also passed clean-package installation against the final cohort.
These runs include the exact Linux candidate lifecycle, disabled required phases, candidate integrity, promotion, persistence, and research regressions.

## Landing and publication

Live PR comments, inline comments, and GitHub reviews were empty at the reviewed head.
The repository has one required approval and `enforce_admins=false`.
The configured owner exception was used under the user's landing authorization after independent source review and all CI jobs passed.
No branch protection was changed.

Publish run: https://github.com/tangle-network/agent-knowledge/actions/runs/34013280992
Publication completed successfully at the merged commit.
Both `verify` and `publish-npm` completed successfully.
Main CI also completed successfully: https://github.com/tangle-network/agent-knowledge/actions/runs/34013245408

## Published package proof

The fresh registry check returned Knowledge 14.0.0 at `gitHead` `30878397a947c37fd743929b30aa03728e785c76`.
The published tarball is `https://registry.npmjs.org/@tangle-network/agent-knowledge/-/agent-knowledge-14.0.0.tgz`.
Its SHA-1 is `1c32c40c8600987ebc9d47f77f052eb4529cb025`.
Its integrity is `sha512-PXcW+uEpXs+quy9r8YKrdVSo1lajz9dmlmEA52b2iG1dvOGkGot3Yct9J5ndEiD6/YePm6lI9yQWofLmX2ryxw==`.
The clean consumer's package lock matches both the registry integrity and tarball URL.

The consumer installation used npm, macOS, and Node 24.11.1.
It installed the published packages in `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-consumer`.
The install completed with 33 packages added in eight seconds.
The package lock has one installed copy each of Knowledge 14.0.0, Eval 0.174.0, Core 0.9.6, Interface 2.0.0, and Zod 4.5.4.
The installed CLI's `version` command returned `14.0.0`.
An initial `--version` invocation was invalid; the CLI documents `version` as its command.

The installed package's functional smoke completed two research rounds using real temporary knowledge storage and scripted sources.
The second worker received steering with zero storage gaps.
Research returned `ready: true` only after driver completion.
Callbacks occurred in this order: worker1, prepare, fold, checkpoint, publish1, worker2, checkpoint, publish2.
The smoke recorded zero provider calls.
It confirmed that this macOS host refuses Linux-only exact candidate execution.
Its disabled-required-phase result is `null` because that branch requires Linux.
The successful Ubuntu CI supplies the Linux-only candidate evidence; this smoke makes no Linux execution claim.

Fresh evidence files:

- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-registry.json`: npm metadata.
- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-smoke.json`: functional result from the registry installation.
- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-consumer/smoke.mjs`: executed smoke source.
- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-integrity.json`: integrity, tarball, dependency versions, and installed-copy assertions.
- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-dependencies.log`: complete relevant dependency tree.
- `/tmp/learning-system-audit-20260905/knowledge-live-cli-version.log`: installed CLI version.
